youtubeIdeas: From your YouTube insights, I found {count} idea(s) grounded in what already works for you.
youtubeEnoughData: Your YouTube data is enough to surface new ideas. Regenerate them with Creator Falco.
overviewConnected: {views} total views across {posts} post(s), all networks combined.
overviewDisconnected: Connect a social network to see your content performance.
instagramNotProfessional: This Instagram account is personal. Switch it to Business or Creator and try again.
instagramError: Instagram connection failed. Try again in a moment.
youtubeNoChannel: No YouTube channel is associated with this Google account. Sign in with the account that owns the channel.
youtubeNoRefreshToken: Google did not return permanent access. Try connecting again, then reconnect Scale X if needed.
youtubeError: YouTube connection failed. Try again in a moment.
youtubeState: I’m looking at the signals from your YouTube channel.
overviewState: Let’s look at your content performance.
formatHelp: YouTube does not provide an official Short indicator through its API. Videos up to 2 minutes are classified as Shorts — a long video published in short format may be classified incorrectly.
instagramCtrHelp: Instagram provides no outbound click data for an organic post — this metric is naturally empty, not a bug.
instagramLeadsHelp: Attributing a lead to a post requires manual linking — this metric stays at 0 for now.
youtubeRetentionHelp: Average percentage of your videos watched by viewers, for the selected period and format — the signal YouTube uses to decide whether a video deserves recommendations.

youtube.topVideosHelp: Your videos ranked by views since connecting your YouTube channel.
youtube.noVideosHelp: Connect your YouTube channel above to see your videos.
youtube.noPeriodHelp: Choose “All” to see the complete history.
youtube.title: Title
youtube.hooksTitle: What makes people click and watch
youtube.retentionHelp: Analysis starts once a video exceeds {views} views. Curves are fetched at each synchronization for your most-viewed videos.
youtube.medianDropOffHelp: The moment you lose half of your audience, measured on each video’s real retention curve. Median, not average: one video dropping at 5 seconds should not distort the figure.
youtube.below30: Under 30 s: your hook is dropping, not your content.
youtube.afterHook: After the hook: look for where the pace falls.
youtube.retention30Help: Share of viewers still watching after 30 seconds — the window where the hook plays out. Videos shorter than 30 seconds are excluded.
youtube.hookGap: {value} retention gap at 30 s between the two. See how you open “{title}” and apply the same structure.
youtube.trafficHelp: Breakdown from YouTube across your most-viewed videos. Search means people actively find you; suggested videos means the algorithm pushes you.
youtube.searchTerms: What people search to find you
youtube.searchHelp: Actual YouTube queries that brought views to your videos — the most reliable material for choosing your next topic.
youtube.importedHelp: Average percentage watched, already retrieved from YouTube for videos over 100 views.
youtube.importedReady: Your videos are analyzed. Detailed curves will be fetched at the next YouTube refresh; the figures above are already usable to compare formats.

explanations.retention: Average percentage of the video watched by viewers — what YouTube uses with watch time to judge whether a video deserves recommendations. Color compares this video to the median of your other videos in the same format.
explanations.watchTime: Total watch time accumulated on this video, in minutes.
explanations.subscribers: Subscribers gained minus subscribers lost, generated directly by this video and reported by YouTube.
explanations.bookings: Booked calls attributed to this video — entered manually because YouTube does not expose this data. Click a video to enter it.
explanations.dealsClosed: Calls from this video that resulted in a sale — entered manually. Click a video to enter it.

table.topPostsHelp: Ranking of your posts, reels, and carousels by total interactions since connecting your Instagram account.
table.topPostsSubtitle: Ranked by interactions across all posts since connection.
table.noPostsHelp: Connect your Instagram account above to see your posts.
table.noPostsPeriodHelp: Choose “All” to see the full history.
table.title: Title
table.followersHelp: New followers generated by this post.

detail.instagramNotice: Outbound clicks on an organic post cannot be measured through the Instagram API, so they do not appear here.
detail.youtubeNotice: YouTube exposes no booking data — enter it here for this video.
